summary: Build practical M&E data analysis skills with Excel, Power BI, statistics, and OECD DAC reporting exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Quantitative analysis for monitoring and evaluation helps teams turn programme data into clear, defensible findings. Designed for M&E officers, evaluation analysts and programme managers, it supports the practical work of preparing data and assessing indicators, results and performance. Learners practise data validation and cleaning, descriptive statistics, subgroup comparisons and trend analysis, then build visualisations and interpret findings with attention to sampling, comparison limits and data quality.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with programme performance data, evaluation evidence, research datasets, and results reporting. It suits foundation-level practitioners who need a structured analytical workflow and intermediate users who want to improve the reliability and communication of their findings.
prerequisites: Prior experience with programme monitoring, evaluation, research, reporting, or operational data is useful but not mandatory. You should be comfortable using a spreadsheet for basic sorting and arithmetic. No programming is required for completion. Advanced statistics, predictive modelling, and production dashboard engineering receive conceptual coverage only. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended. Power BI Desktop may be used for the dashboard exercise where available, but the course can provide screenshots or templates when installation is not possible.
